I understand that's frustrating. Unfortunately, no—the replacement fern isn't covered by a guarantee. According to our policy, a replacement plant gets its own new 30-day guarantee and can be replaced once more if it fails, but the plant sent as that second replacement has no guarantee.

Since your first replacement died within 3 weeks, it would have been eligible for one more free replacement under its own 30-day guarantee. If you haven't claimed that yet, I'd recommend submitting a claim through "My Orders" with two photos (whole plant + close-up) within the 30-day window from when you received it—a Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days. Would you like help with anything else?
